external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library service to borrow, renew and reserve books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manually extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login, with the password kept on a card under the desk.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members request borrowing, renewals and reservations and which calls the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk that scans a member's library card and books and sends loan and return events to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The text describes kiosks in every branch as one named component type.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the service's sole interface for reading and changing loans, members and reservations.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Exposure is disputed: Lending service note says 'The lending API is internal-only.' Interview transcript says 'The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.' The attribute is therefore unknown.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, contact details and full borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The earlier two-database arrangement was corrected to one loans database; the old reservations database is gone.

data_flows.name: borrow book
data_flows.description: A member requests a book borrowing operation through the phone app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member
data_flows.data_description: The member and book involved in a borrowing request.

data_flows.name: renew loan
data_flows.description: A member requests renewal of a loan through the phone app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: what happens when someone renews a loan or reserves a title in the app.
data_flows.data_description: A member, book and loan renewal request.

data_flows.name: reserve title
data_flows.description: A member requests a title reservation through the phone app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Reserving is the same shape, the app asks for a title and the API puts the member in the queue for it.
data_flows.data_description: A member and title reservation request.

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a scanned loan to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: A member's scanned library card, book and loan information.

data_flows.name: send return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a scanned book return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: A member's scanned library card, returned book and return information.

data_flows.name: extend loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff extend a member's loan through the circulation page served by the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.data_description: A member's loan and its extension.

data_flows.name: clear block
data_flows.description: Desk staff clear a block on a member's account through the circulation page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.
data_flows.data_description: A member account block and the action clearing it.

data_flows.name: mark returned
data_flows.description: Desk staff manually mark a book as returned through the circulation page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned
data_flows.notes: The history records that the loan was closed by hand; the shared account does not identify the individual or branch.
data_flows.data_description: A member's loan and the manual return action.

data_flows.name: read loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads member, loan and reservation records from the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Member records, loans, reservations and borrowing history.

data_flows.name: write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API writes changes to member, loan and reservation records in the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Changes to member records, loans and reservations.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: phone
trust_boundaries.description: A member's phone environment hosting the library app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network through which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database has confidential data classification.
assumptions.basis: The database contains names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history, which are personal and business-sensitive records.
